component.name: Running Progress Tracker
component.summary: Track and analyze your running progress from Strava

description.p: Running Progress Tracker (RunTrend) is a personal desktop application for analyzing running training from Strava. It synchronizes your activities locally and answers concrete training questions instead of just plotting more diagrams.

ul.li: Overview: distance, pace, frequency per week or month, with smoothing
Heart Rate: HR range, average HR, Efficiency Factor, zone distribution
Endurance: longest run and average distance per run
Performance: age-adjusted percentage via WMA-2023 factors plus Aerobic Capacity from Tanaka HRmax
Trend (0-100): self-relative composite of volume, frequency, pace and efficiency against your own rolling baseline
Training Load (ACWR): daily Gabbett 7:28 ratio, TRIMP-based when HR is configured
Training Fitness (CTL) and Form (TSB) in the summary panel as absolute training-load readouts
Race predictions: 5K, 10K, Half, Marathon via McMillan + HR-classified easy pace

description.p: Every contested metric carries an in-app tooltip with source and caveat, and the user manual lists which numbers come from peer-reviewed work (Banister 1991, Coggan, Gabbett 2016, Impellizzeri 2020, Tanaka 2001, WMA 2023) vs. RunTrend's own design. Data stays local in SQLite — no server, no tracking, no cloud uploads.

screenshot.caption: Main window showing distance progress chart

ul.li: Strava OAuth integration with automatic token refresh and incremental sync
Chart tabs: Overview, Heart Rate, HR Zones, Endurance, Duration, Structure, Performance, Trend, Training Load, Projection, Runs
Performance tab with WMA-2023 age-adjusted percentage and Aerobic Capacity from Tanaka HRmax
Training Fitness (CTL), Form (TSB) and Training Trend (0-100) in the summary panel
Daily Gabbett 7:28 ACWR with TRIMP-based load source (Banister 1991), distance fallback when HR is missing
Race time predictions for 5K, 10K, Half Marathon, Marathon via McMillan with HR-classified easy pace
Methodological caveats baked into every contested metric tooltip; full caveat table in the user manual
Local SQLite storage, no cloud component, bilingual (German and English) with auto-detection
